verdict.rationale: Jina Reader uses headless Chrome internally (x-engine: browser, x-wait-for-selector, cookie forwarding) to render pages and return LLM-friendly output. These are one-shot fetch-and-convert controls, not a managed remote browser sandbox that a developer can drive interactively or manually. Nothing in the evidence documents a live, user-controllable browser session, so the applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows
